Name: Fashion Sense - Save All Your Outfits
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[color=#3d85c6][size=5]Fashion Sense - Save All Your Outfits[/size][/color]
Fashion Sense Save All Outfits is a small utility mod for players who use Fashion Sense and want an easier way to back up their saved outfits.
Normally, Fashion Sense allows you to copy the JSON of one saved outfit at a time. This mod makes that process much faster by exporting all saved outfits at once, with each outfit saved in its own separate JSON file.

[color=#3d85c6][size=5]Features[/size][/color]
Export all saved outfits from Fashion Sense at once.
Each outfit set is saved as an individual .json file.
Files are named according to the name of the saved outfit.
Backups are organized by saved file, player name, date, and time.
Re-import outfit sets from an Imports folder.
Optional automatic export whenever the game is saved.

[color=#3d85c6][size=5]Default Controls[/size][/color]
F8 - Export all saved outfits in Fashion Sense.
F9 - Import outfits from the Imports folder.

Shortcut keys can be changed through the Generic Mod Config Menu, if installed, or manually through the config.json file.

[color=#3d85c6][size=5]Where are exported outfits stored?[/size][/color]
Exported outfit sets are saved within the mod folder:
Mods/Fashion Sense Save All Outfits/Backups/

The mod creates folders like this:
Backups/
Save_123456789_PlayerName/
2026-05-05_15-24-10/
Outfit Name.json
Another Outfit.json
This helps prevent backups from different saved games or characters from being mixed up.

[color=#3d85c6][size=5]How to import outfits[/size][/color]
To import outfit sets, place the .json files of the outfit sets inside the following directory:
Mods/Fashion Sense Save All Outfits/Imports/

Then, load your saved game and press the shortcut key to import, which by default is F9. If the Fashion Sense menu is already open, close it and reopen it. If the imported clothes don't appear immediately, save the game and reload the save.

[color=#3d85c6][size=5]Import Behavior[/size][/color]
By default, imported clothes are added to your current Fashion Sense clothing collection.
There is also a configuration option called:

ReplaceExistingOnImport

If set to true, the current clothing collection will be replaced by the imported clothes.
Use this option with caution. It is recommended to make a backup before replacing your current clothes.

[color=#3d85c6][size=5]Notes[/size][/color]
This mod does not create clothes itself. It only backs up and restores clothes that have been saved by Fashion Sense.

Always back up your saved games and important clothes, especially before using import options that replace existing data.
